note: Lean keeps the two coefficients `3c₁/2√(2x/c₂)` and `20c₀c₂^{3/2}/(3π²)√(2x)` separate in `bound_4_41` (with `log(2x/c₂)`, `log(2ex/c₂)`) and bounds them numerically at the first choice; there is no constant `c_{9,I}`.

snippet.text:
noncomputable def bound_4_41 (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (D : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let c₁ := 1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)
  2 * √(c₀ * c₁) / π * D * Real.log (rexp 1 * x / D) +
    3 * c₁ / 2 * (x / q) * logPlus (D / (c₂ * x / q)) * Real.log (q / c₂) +
    (2 * eta2'L1 / π * max 1 (Real.log (c₀ * rexp 3 * q ^ 2 / (4 * π * eta2'L1 * x))) *
        Real.log x +
      2 * √(c₀ * c₁) / π * (√3 + 1 / 2 * logPlus (D / (q / 2))) * Real.log (q / c₂)) * q +
    3 * c₁ / 2 * √(2 * x / c₂) * Real.log (2 * x / c₂) +
    20 * c₀ * c₂ ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) / (3 * π ^ 2) * √(2 * x) * Real.log (2 * rexp 1 * x / c₂)

proof_context.conclusion: Defines the (4.41) error term, including `3c₁/2 (x/q) log⁺(D/(c₂x/q)) log(q/c₂)`, the `q`-terms with `(√3 + ½log⁺(D/(q/2)))log(q/c₂)`, and the `√x` terms `3c₁/2 √(2x/c₂) log(2x/c₂) + (20c₀c₂^{3/2}/3π²) √(2x) log(2ex/c₂)`.
